note: The org-wide contract every repository's Baseline ruleset must satisfy. Rulesets themselves are per-repository and stay that way; this file is what makes them comparable. JSON carries no comments, so the reasoning lives in docs/rulesets.md — read it before editing anything here.

exceptions.reason: Set to 0 by deployments PR #110 (ci(rulesets): let the release bot merge its own appVersion bumps, merged 2026-08-02), together with a CODEOWNERS that deliberately has no catch-all, so the release bot can merge the chart bumps it opens. Raising it to 1 would stall that pipeline. Closes when release versions no longer arrive as bot-merged pull requests, or when a second reviewer exists; platform docs/adr/0018-agentic-app-topology.md section 1 has the full history and reads the surrounding App bypass as vestigial.
